findings.label: Per-item cap is not batch bound
findings.detail: --max_length bounds each item, not the padded batch; a 700 x 8192 padded batch can still exceed 8Gi. FIX 1 (Zoo batching) and FIX 2 (OmniRoute split) remain the real OOM guard.

findings.label: Request below loaded usage
findings.detail: 2Gi request is under the measured 2.4-3.4 GiB post-rollout cgroup usage, so pods rank first for kubelet eviction under node pressure. Consider 3Gi per the report, or record why 2Gi is wanted.

findings.label: Comment overstates Zoo's item cap
findings.detail: Manifest comment says Zoo caps items at 8191 tokens, but Zoo uses a chars/4 estimate; dense content could exceed 8192 real tokens and 400 the whole batch. Reword to 'estimated tokens' and pursue the upstream OVMS truncation fix.
